_comment: Additive merge snippet consumed by install/install.sh Step 6. Wires the three nerve lifecycle hooks (SessionStart warm-start, PostToolUse capture, Stop consolidate) and adds the engine permissions. It is MERGED into ~/.claude/settings.json, never overwriting it: existing PreToolUse entries (rtk hook claude, project guardrail.sh) and any other hooks/permissions are preserved. PreToolUse is intentionally omitted here — the installer keeps whatever is already wired.
